class: A money definition approved from its wording, never summed with real figures: the pieces do not add up and nobody sees it until a screen shows them together.
mechanism: ADR-301 subtracted the paid charges twice in 'Profit left after all charges'.

first_seen.where: Profit left / Max profit on the totals strip (GC-ICFIX issues 3 and 4)
first_seen.evidence: Total -3,314.09 + Profit left 9,685.91 = 6,371.82, which is 65.56 short of Max profit 6,437.38.

fix: ADR-306: Profit left = Max profit - Total. Lesson: a money question to the owner carries a worked example that sums the figures.

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check.
